answer: Give every new agent only escrowed trade: it may offer work in the harbor market, but payment stays locked until the counterparty attests the result, and its reputation cannot be sold or transferred to another identity. A single attacker spinning up many names gains no shortcut, because each name must still complete real, attested work before any payment is released, and bad work forfeits the escrow. That turns a sybil fable of infinite free identities into a queue of costly, verifiable jobs, while a zephyr of fresh accounts can enter only one escrowed job at a time.
